plugins.name: greple
plugins.description: Block-oriented grep with region control: AND search within functions/paragraphs, whole-block output, region-restricted and cross-line phrase search

plugins.name: textconv
plugins.description: Let any command (cat, grep, diff, greple) read PDF, Office documents, and git objects as text via optex -Mtextconv

plugins.name: dozo
plugins.description: Run commands inside the Docker image a project expects, with the repository mounted and the working directory preserved; its default image (tecolicom/xlate) provides greple, sdif, mdee and other text tools

plugins.name: side-by-side
plugins.description: Show two texts next to each other in the terminal (original/translation, two versions) with ansicolumn -V, mdee -V, sdif -V on conflict markers, cdif --lxl on line pairs, plain text or a Markdown table in any agent's reply, or in color inside a Claude Code reply via a MessageDisplay hook

plugins.name: sdif
plugins.description: Word-level and side-by-side diffs with cdif, sdif and watchdiff: check a corrected draft word by word, compare Japanese by MeCab word units, read git diff output, print the word marks as text for agents
